mapper.select: SELECT /* LGVPAY00026.retrievePayrollRunList */ pce.payroll_calculation_exec_id , pce.payroll_calculation_set_id , pacs.payroll_calculation_set_name , pcpb.payroll_calc_period_value AS and pcpb.payroll_calc_period_value = peie.payment_yyyymm ) AS email_count , (SELECT count(1) FROM tb_pay_slip_send_n peie, tb_pay_calc_emp_exec_n pcee WHERE pcee.payroll_calculation_exec_id = pce.payroll_calculation_exec_id and nvl(pcee.error_flag,'N') = 'N' AND pcee.employee_no = peie.employee_no and pcpb.payroll_calc_period_value = peie.payment_yyyymm and peie.slip_creation_flag = 'Y') AS create_payslip_count , (SELECT count(1) FROM tb_pay_slip_send_n peie, tb_pay_calc_emp_exec_n pcee WHERE pcee.payroll_calculation_exec_id = pce.payroll_calculation_exec_id and nvl(pcee.error_flag,'N') = 'N' AND pcee.employee_no = peie.employee_no and pcpb.payroll_calc_period_value = peie.payment_yyyymm and peie.transfer_flag = 'Y') AS send_email_count , SELECT /* LGVPAY00026.retrievePaySlipAttendanceList */ to_char(ar.time_and_attendance_date, 'dd/mm') AS attendance_ymd ,ar.a_day_of_the_week_code AS screen_week_name ,(SELECT lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('LGVHR_DAY_OF_WEEK', ar.a_day_of_the_week_code, NULL, 'cn') FROM DUAL) VIET_WEEK_NAME ,em.organization_id AS employee_org ,ar.employee_no AS employee_no ,em.full_name_local AS employee_name ,em.grade_title AS employee_grade ,ac.time_and_attendance_type_code AS actual_attendance_type ,ar.time_and_attendance_code AS actual_attendance_detail ,(SELECT NVL(lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('LGVHR_ATTENDANCE_ACTUAL_CODE', ar.time_and_attendance_code, NULL, 'cn'), ' ') FROM DUAL) AS ATTENDANCE_NAME ,ar.time_attend_detail_code AS actual_attend_detail_reason ,(SELECT NVL(lgvhr_common_pkg.decode_lookup('LGVHR_ATTENDANCE_DETAIL_CODE', ar.time_attend_detail_code, NULL, 'cn'), ' ') FROM DUAL) AS ATTENDANCE_DETAIL_NAME ,ar.shift_type_code AS actual_shift_code ,ar.night_shift_flag AS actual_day_night ,ar.evening_meal_flag AS actual_dinner_chk ,ar.work_start_time AS actual_start_tm ,NVL(ar.overtime_sum_hours, 0) AS actual_o_t ,NVL(ar.weekday_overtime_hours, 0) AS weekday ,NVL(ar.holiday_overtime_hours, 0) AS weekday_holiday ,NVL(ar.public_holiday_overtime_hours, 0) AS public_holiday ,NVL(ar.weekday_night_overtime_hours, 0) AS at_night_weekday ,NVL(ar.weekday_ot_af_night_work_hours, 0) AS at_night_weekday_after_o_t ,NVL(ar.holiday_night_overtime_hours, 0) AS at_night_weekday_holiday ,NVL(ar.public_holiday_night_ot_hours, 0) AS at_night_public_holiday
,NVL(ar.weekday_overtime_hours, 0) +NVL(ar.holiday_overtime_hours, 0) +NVL(ar.public_holiday_overtime_hours, 0) +NVL(ar.weekday_night_overtime_hours, 0) +NVL(ar.weekday_ot_af_night_work_hours, 0) +NVL(ar.holiday_night_overtime_hours, 0) +NVL(ar.public_holiday_night_ot_hours, 0) +NVL(so.overtime_sum_hours, 0) AS total_ot
,NVL(ar.normal_night_overtime_hours, 0) AS night_normal ,NVL(ar.tardy_hours, 0) AS deduction_lateness ,NVL(ar.early_leave_hours, 0) AS deduction_leaving_early ,NVL(ar.going_out_hours, 0) AS deduction_going_out , NVL(ar.tardy_hours, 0) +NVL(ar.early_leave_hours, 0) +NVL(ar.going_out_hours, 0) AS deduction_sub_total ,NVL(so.overtime_sum_hours, 0) AS special_o_t ,ar.base_time_attend_apply_flag AS base_att_flag FROM tb_att_result_n ar ,emp_master em ,tb_att_special_ot_result_n so ,tb_att_code_c ac WHERE ar.employee_no = em.employee_number AND ar.employee_no = so.employee_no(+) AND ar.time_and_attendance_date = so.time_and_attendance_date(+) AND ar.time_and_attendance_code = ac.time_and_attendance_code AND ar.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND ar.time_and_attendance_yyyymm = #{payMonth} AND 'Y' = so.confirm_flag(+) AND ar.employee_no = #{employeeNo} ORDER BY ar.employee_no, ar.time_and_attendance_date ASC

SELECT /* LGVPAY00026.retrievePaySlipAttendanceTottalList */ SUM(NVL(ar.weekday_overtime_hours, 0)) AS weekday ,SUM(NVL(ar.holiday_overtime_hours, 0)) AS weekday_holiday ,SUM(NVL(ar.public_holiday_overtime_hours, 0)) AS public_holiday ,SUM(NVL(ar.weekday_night_overtime_hours, 0)) AS at_night_weekday ,SUM(NVL(ar.weekday_ot_af_night_work_hours, 0)) AS at_night_weekday_after_o_t ,SUM(NVL(ar.holiday_night_overtime_hours, 0)) AS at_night_weekday_holiday ,SUM(NVL(ar.public_holiday_night_ot_hours, 0)) AS at_night_public_holiday
,SUM(NVL(ar.weekday_overtime_hours, 0) +NVL(ar.holiday_overtime_hours, 0) +NVL(ar.public_holiday_overtime_hours, 0) +NVL(ar.weekday_night_overtime_hours, 0) +NVL(ar.weekday_ot_af_night_work_hours, 0) +NVL(ar.holiday_night_overtime_hours, 0) +NVL(ar.public_holiday_night_ot_hours, 0) +NVL(so.overtime_sum_hours, 0)) AS total_ot
,SUM(NVL(ar.normal_night_overtime_hours, 0)) AS night_normal ,SUM(NVL(ar.tardy_hours, 0)) AS deduction_lateness ,SUM(NVL(ar.early_leave_hours, 0)) AS deduction_leaving_early ,SUM(NVL(ar.going_out_hours, 0)) AS deduction_going_out ,SUM(NVL(ar.tardy_hours, 0) +NVL(ar.early_leave_hours, 0) +NVL(ar.going_out_hours, 0)) AS deduction_sub_total ,SUM(NVL(so.overtime_sum_hours, 0)) AS special_o_t , lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(max(ar.subsidiary_code),max(ar.employee_no), to_date(max(ar.time_and_attendance_yyyymm), 'YYYYMM'), LAST_DAY(to_date(max(ar.time_and_attendance_yyyymm), 'YYYYMM')),'year_total_ot_result') AS year_ot_total FROM tb_att_result_n ar ,emp_master em ,tb_att_special_ot_result_n so ,tb_att_code_c ac WHERE ar.employee_no = em.employee_number AND ar.employee_no = so.employee_no(+) AND ar.time_and_attendance_date = so.time_and_attendance_date(+) AND ar.time_and_attendance_code = ac.time_and_attendance_code AND ar.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND ar.time_and_attendance_yyyymm = #{payMonth} AND 'Y' = so.confirm_flag(+) AND ar.employee_no = #{employeeNo} ORDER BY ar.employee_no, ar.time_and_attendance_date ASC

{call lgvpay_upload_pkg.update_payroll_employee_email(#{errorCode, mode=OUT, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, /* p_errcode */ #{errorMsg , mode=OUT, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, /* p_errbuf */ #{payrollCalculationExecId, mode=IN , jdbcType=NUMERIC, javaType=string}, #{payFlag , mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, #{payError , mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, #{payType , mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, #{payMonth , mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, #{employeeNo , mode=IN, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string}, /* p_pay_month */ #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId, mode=IN , jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=string} /* p_application_user_id */ )}

select /* LGVPAY00026.retrieveSalaryDetailData */ TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(NIGHT_HOURS),0), 'FM9990.0') AS NIGHT_HOURS ,TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(OT_HOURS),0), 'FM9990.0') AS OT_HOURS ,TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(OTNT_HOURS),0), 'FM9990.0') AS OTNT_HOURS ,TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(LATENESS_HOURS),0), 'FM9990.0') AS LATENESS_HOURS ,TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(LEAVING_EARLY_HOURS),0), 'FM9990.0') AS LEAVING_EARLY_HOURS ,TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(GOOUT_HOURS),0), 'FM9990.0') AS GOOUT_HOURS ,TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(HELPCALL_SUPPORT_HOURS),0), 'FM9990.0') AS HELPCALL_SUPPORT_HOURS ,TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(ACT_WORKING_DAYS),0), 'FM9990') AS ACT_WORKING_DAYS ,TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(ABSENCE_LEAVE_DAYS),0), 'FM9990') AS ABSENCE_LEAVE_DAYS ,TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(PAID_LEAVE_DAYS),0), 'FM9990') AS PAID_LEAVE_DAYS ,TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(UNPAID_LEAVE_DAYS),0), 'FM9990') AS UNPAID_LEAVE_DAYS ,TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(SUSPENSION_LEAVE_DAYS),0), 'FM9990') AS SUSPENSION_LEAVE_DAYS ,TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(INCOME_TIME_N_AMOUNT),0), 'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS INCOME_TIME_N_AMOUNT ,TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(INCOME_TIME_Y_AMOUNT),0), 'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS INCOME_TIME_Y_AMOUNT ,TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(DEDUCTION_AMOUNT),0), 'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS DEDUCTION_AMOUNT ,MAX(BANK_NAME) AS BANK_NAME ,MAX(BANK_ACCOUNT_NO) AS BANK_ACCOUNT_NO ,TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(SALARY_TOTAL_AMOUNT),0), 'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS SALARY_TOTAL_AMOUNT ,TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(DEDUCTION_TOTAL_AMOUNT),0), 'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS DEDUCTION_TOTAL_AMOUNT ,TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(BANK_TRANSFER_AMOUNT),0), 'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS BANK_TRANSFER_AMOUNT
from (SELECT
NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(pid.additional_input_value, 'x') <> 'PAY_VALUE' AND NVL(ccc1.common_code, 'x') = 'NT' THEN to_number(pcr.result_value) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS night_hours , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(pid.additional_input_value, 'x') <> 'PAY_VALUE' AND NVL(ccc1.common_code, 'x') = 'OT' THEN to_number(pcr.result_value) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ot_hours , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(pid.additional_input_value, 'x') <> 'PAY_VALUE' AND NVL(ccc1.common_code, 'x') = 'OTNT' THEN to_number(pcr.result_value) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS otnt_hours
, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(pid.additional_input_value, 'x') <> 'PAY_VALUE' AND NVL(ccc1.common_code, 'x') = 'ATT_DED' AND NVL(ccc.common_code, 'x') = 'LATENESS' THEN to_number(pcr.result_value) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lateness_hours , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(pid.additional_input_value, 'x') <> 'PAY_VALUE' AND NVL(ccc1.common_code, 'x') = 'ATT_DED' AND NVL(ccc.common_code, 'x') = 'LEAVING_EARLY' THEN to_number(pcr.result_value) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS leaving_early_hours , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(pid.additional_input_value, 'x') <> 'PAY_VALUE' AND NVL(ccc1.common_code, 'x') = 'ATT_DED' AND NVL(ccc.common_code, 'x') = 'GOOUT' THEN to_number(pcr.result_value) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS goout_hours , NVL(prs.helpcall_support_hours, 0) AS helpcall_support_hours /* special ot */
, NVL(prs.working_days, 0) AS act_working_days , NVL(prs.absence_days, 0) AS absence_leave_days , NVL(prs.paid_vacation_days, 0) AS paid_leave_days , NVL(prs.unpaid_vacation_days, 0) AS unpaid_leave_days , NVL(prs.unpaid_absence_leave_days, 0) + NVL(prs.paid_absence_leave_days, 0) AS suspension_leave_days
, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(pid.additional_input_value, 'x') = 'PAY_VALUE' AND NVL(ccc1.code_data1_value, 'x') = 'INCOME' AND NVL(ccc1.code_data2_value, 'x') = 'TIME_N' THEN to_number(pcr.result_value) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_time_n_amount , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(pid.additional_input_value, 'x') = 'PAY_VALUE' AND NVL(ccc1.code_data1_value, 'x') = 'INCOME' AND NVL(ccc1.code_data2_value, 'x') = 'TIME_Y' THEN to_number(pcr.result_value) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income_time_y_amount , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(pid.additional_input_value, 'x') = 'PAY_VALUE' AND NVL(ccc1.code_data1_value, 'x') = 'DEDUCTION' THEN /* deduction의 attendance 만 abs처리 하고 그외는 원래 값으로 계산 함 */ CASE WHEN NVL(ccc1.common_code, 'x') = 'ATT_DED' THEN ABS(to_number(pcr.result_value)) ELSE to_number(pcr.result_value) END ELSE 0 END), 0) AS deduction_amount /* deduction의 attendance항목 금액이 (-)이므로 abs처리 함 */
, prs.bank_name AS bank_name , prs.payment_bank_account_no AS bank_account_no , NVL(prs.salary_total_amount , 0) AS salary_total_amount /* gross salary */ , NVL(prs.deduction_total_amount, 0) AS deduction_total_amount /* deduction */ , NVL(prs.bank_transfer_amount , 0) AS bank_transfer_amount /* net salary */ FROM tb_pay_calc_exec_n pce , tb_pay_calc_result_n pcr , tb_pay_payroll_item_m ppi , tb_pay_item_detail_n pid , tb_pay_payroll_item_m ppi2 , lgcom_common_code_c ccc , lgcom_common_code_c ccc1 , tb_pay_result_s prs WHERE pcr.payroll_calculation_exec_id = pce.payroll_calculation_exec_id AND ppi.payroll_item_id = pcr.payroll_item_id AND pid.payroll_item_id = ppi.payroll_item_id AND pcr.payroll_item_detail_detail_id = pid.payroll_item_detail_detail_id AND ppi2.payroll_item_id = NVL(ppi.parent_payroll_item_id, ppi.payroll_item_id)
AND pcr.payroll_calculation_exec_id IN
#{payrollCalculationExecIdList[${idx}], jdbcType=NUMERIC}
AND 1=2
AND pcr.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND ccc.code_type_code = 'LGDVH_PAY_SLIP_INQ_2ND_TYPE_CODE' AND ccc.common_code = ppi.payroll_item_inq_class_code AND ccc1.code_type_code = ccc.parent_code_type_code --'LGDVH_PAY_SLIP_INQ_1ST_TYPE_CODE' AND ccc1.common_code = ccc.parent_common_code AND prs.payroll_calculation_exec_id = pcr.payroll_calculation_exec_id AND prs.employee_no = pcr.employee_no
GROUP BY NVL(prs.helpcall_support_hours, 0) , NVL(prs.working_days, 0) , NVL(prs.absence_days, 0) , NVL(prs.paid_vacation_days, 0) , NVL(prs.unpaid_vacation_days, 0) , NVL(prs.unpaid_absence_leave_days, 0) + NVL(prs.paid_absence_leave_days, 0) , prs.bank_name , prs.payment_bank_account_no , NVL(prs.salary_total_amount , 0) , NVL(prs.deduction_total_amount, 0) , NVL(prs.bank_transfer_amount , 0) ) n

SELECT /* LGVPAY00026.retrieveSalaryDetailListSend */ cccm1.common_code_name AS code_name1 /*1차분류*/ , cccm.common_code_name AS code_name2 /*2차분류*/
, TO_CHAR(SUM(CASE WHEN pid.additional_input_value = 'PAY_VALUE' THEN /* deduction의 attendance 만 abs 처리하고, 그외는 그냥 보여줌 */ CASE WHEN ccc1.code_data1_value = 'DEDUCTION' AND ccc1.common_code = 'ATT_DED' THEN ABS(NVL(to_number(pcr.result_value), 0)) ELSE NVL(to_number(pcr.result_value), 0) END END), 'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS item_amount /* 금액 */ , TO_CHAR(SUM(CASE WHEN pid.additional_input_value = 'PAY_VALUE' THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN ccc1.code_data2_value = 'TIME_N' THEN NULL /* Non Working인 경우 DEDUCTION_DAYS만 가져오기 위한 조건 */ WHEN ccc1.code_data2_value = 'TIME_Y' AND ccc1.common_code = 'ATT_DED' AND ccc.common_code = 'NON_WORKING' THEN DECODE( pid.additional_input_value, 'DEDUCTION_DAYS', pcr.result_value) ELSE pcr.result_value END END), DECODE(ccc.code_data1_value, 'D', 'FM9990', 'FM9990.0')) AS item_hours /* 시간/기타정보. TIME_Y인 경우만 값 조회되도록 함. */
, dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY ccc1.common_code ORDER BY ccc1.sort_order_no, DECODE( #{incomeDeductionCode}||'_'||#{incomeDeductionTimeCode}, 'INCOME_TIME_Y', 1, SIGN(ABS(SUM(decode(pid.additional_input_value, 'PAY_VALUE', NVL(pcr.result_value, 0))))) ) DESC, ccc.sort_order_no) AS rank1 /* 2차분류 순서 */ , COUNT(1) OVER (PARTITION BY ccc1.common_code) AS rowspan_cnt1 /* 1차분류 병합 행수 */ , ccc1.code_data2_value AS time_display_code /* 시간 보여줄지 여부. TIME_Y:보여줌, TIME_N:안보여줌 */ , ccc.code_data1_value AS day_hour_code /* 일자(D), 시간(H) 구분코드 */ , ccc1.common_code AS code1 /*1차분류코드*/ , ccc.common_code AS code2 /*2차분류코드*/ FROM tb_pay_calc_exec_n pce , tb_pay_calc_result_n pcr , tb_pay_payroll_item_m ppi , tb_pay_item_detail_n pid , tb_pay_payroll_item_m ppi2 , lgcom_common_code_c ccc , lgcom_common_code_c ccc1 , lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c cccm , lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c cccm1 , tb_pay_result_s prs /* pay result 있는 경우만 데이터 조회되도록 join 추가 */ WHERE pcr.payroll_calculation_exec_id = pce.payroll_calculation_exec_id AND ppi.payroll_item_id = pcr.payroll_item_id AND pid.payroll_item_id = ppi.payroll_item_id AND pcr.payroll_item_detail_detail_id = pid.payroll_item_detail_detail_id AND ppi2.payroll_item_id = NVL(ppi.parent_payroll_item_id, ppi.payroll_item_id)
AND pcr.payroll_calculation_exec_id IN
#{payrollCalculationExecIdList[${idx}], jdbcType=NUMERIC}
AND 1=2
AND pcr.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND ccc.code_type_code = 'LGDVH_PAY_SLIP_INQ_2ND_TYPE_CODE' AND ccc.common_code = ppi.payroll_item_inq_class_code AND ccc1.code_type_code = ccc.parent_code_type_code --'LGDVH_PAY_SLIP_INQ_1ST_TYPE_CODE' AND ccc1.common_code = ccc.parent_common_code AND cccm1.code_type_code = ccc1.code_type_code AND cccm1.common_code = ccc1.common_code AND cccm.code_type_code = ccc.code_type_code AND cccm.common_code = ccc.common_code AND cccm1.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND cccm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND ccc1.code_data1_value = #{incomeDeductionCode} /* INCOME, DEDUCTION 구분 */
AND ccc1.code_data2_value = #{incomeDeductionTimeCode} /* TIME_N, TIME_Y 구분 */
AND prs.payroll_calculation_exec_id = pcr.payroll_calculation_exec_id AND prs.employee_no = pcr.employee_no
GROUP BY cccm1.common_code_name , cccm.common_code_name , ccc.sort_order_no , ccc1.sort_order_no , ccc1.common_code , ccc1.code_data2_value , ccc.code_data1_value , ccc1.common_code , ccc.common_code
ORDER BY ccc1.sort_order_no , DECODE( #{incomeDeductionCode}||'_'||#{incomeDeductionTimeCode}, 'INCOME_TIME_Y', 1, SIGN(ABS(SUM(decode(pid.additional_input_value, 'PAY_VALUE', NVL(pcr.result_value, 0))))) ) DESC /* 금액이 있는 건을 우선 보여준다. 단, OT는 항목순서대로 */ , ccc.sort_order_no

SELECT /* LGVPAY00026.retrieveAdjustmentListSend */ ppi.payroll_item_name AS element_code , ppi.inquiry_name AS element_name , TO_CHAR(SUM(decode(pid.additional_input_value, 'PAY_VALUE', NVL(pcr.result_value, 0))), 'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS element_amount FROM tb_pay_calc_exec_n pce , tb_pay_calc_result_n pcr , tb_pay_payroll_item_m ppi , tb_pay_item_detail_n pid , tb_pay_payroll_item_m ppi2 , lgcom_common_code_c ccc WHERE pcr.payroll_calculation_exec_id = pce.payroll_calculation_exec_id AND ppi.payroll_item_id = pcr.payroll_item_id AND pid.payroll_item_id = ppi.payroll_item_id AND pcr.payroll_item_detail_detail_id = pid.payroll_item_detail_detail_id AND ppi2.payroll_item_id = NVL(ppi.parent_payroll_item_id, ppi.payroll_item_id)
AND pcr.payroll_calculation_exec_id IN
#{payrollCalculationExecIdList[${idx}], jdbcType=NUMERIC}
AND 1=2
AND pcr.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND ccc.code_type_code = 'LGDVH_PAY_SLIP_INQ_2ND_TYPE_CODE' AND ccc.common_code = ppi.payroll_item_inq_class_code AND ccc.common_code = 'ADJ_INCOME'
GROUP BY ppi.payroll_item_name, ppi.inquiry_name

SELECT /* LGVPAY00026.retrieveOtherIncomeInputList */ TO_CHAR(peo.payment, 'FM999,999,999,999,990') AS payment , NVL(peo.remark,' ') AS remark , NVL(peo.ap_number,' ') AS ap_number , NVL(peo.pic_id,' ') AS pic_id , NVL(peo.pic_name,' ') AS pic_name , 1 AS SORT_ORDER FROM tb_pay_emp_other_income_n peo WHERE peo.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND peo.payment_yyyymm = #{payMonth} UNION ALL SELECT /* LGVPAY00026.retrieveOtherIncomeInputList */ NVL(TO_CHAR(SUM(peo.payment), 'FM999,999,999,999,990'), ' ') AS payment , 'Tổng' AS remark , ' ' AS ap_number , ' ' AS pic_id , ' ' AS pic_name , 2 AS SORT_ORDER FROM tb_pay_emp_other_income_n peo WHERE peo.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND peo.payment_yyyymm = #{payMonth}
ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC
